target.title: fix(msteams): normalize inbound mentions and forwards
target.body:
Closes #102376

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Microsoft Teams users would send mentions, quoted replies, or forwarded messages and the agent would receive incomplete or misleading text. Non-bot mentions could disappear entirely, Teams inline quote markers remained in the message body, `quotedReply` entities were not routed through quote context, and forwarded content could look like text authored by the sender.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a Teams-owned inbound normalizer before monitor dispatch. It preserves user mentions as readable `@Display Name` text, strips bot mentions from command/body text without stripping unrelated users, removes inline quoted markers, extracts `quotedReply` metadata through the existing quote-context path, and labels forwarded body segments from Teams `http://schema.skype.com/Forward` HTML blockquotes.

Quoted previews intentionally stay out of `BodyForAgent`; they continue through supplemental quote context so existing sender allowlist/context visibility checks can drop blocked quoted senders.

## User Impact

Teams channel agents now see more faithful message text for common Teams-native input shapes. Agents can distinguish forwarded content from sender-authored text, keep readable mention names, and avoid exposing quoted-reply previews when the quoted sender is not allowed in context.

## Evidence

Before evidence:

```shell
Current-main source proof:
extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.ts:
  const rawText = activity.text?.trim() ?? "";
  const htmlText = extractTextFromHtmlAttachments(attachments);
  const valueText =
    rawText || htmlText ? "" : serializeMSTeamsAdaptiveCardActionValue(activity.value);
  const text = stripMSTeamsMentionTags(rawText || htmlText || valueText || "");

extensions/msteams/src/inbound.ts:
  export function stripMSTeamsMentionTags(text: string): string {
    // Teams wraps mentions in <at>...</at> tags
    return text.replace(/<at[^>]*>.*?<\/at>/gi, "").trim();
  }

Negative search on upstream/main:
  git grep -n "quotedReply\\|schema\\.skype\\.com/Forward\\|buildMSTeamsNormalizedText\\|normalizeMSTeamsMentionText\\|Forwarded message" upstream/main -- extensions/msteams/src
  # no matches
```

After-fix terminal capture from the rebased PR head:

```shell
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.authz.test.ts --reporter=verbose
```

Additional checks:

```shell
$ corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions
$ OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
$ git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
```

All three commands exited 0.

Autoreview:

```shell
$ .agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local
autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported
overall: patch is correct (0.82)
```

Remote Testbox note: I attempted the preferred Blacksmith Testbox path, but `node scripts/crabbox-wrapper.mjs warmup --provider blacksmith-testbox --keep --timing-json` was blocked because the selected `crabbox` binary was version `0.12.0` and the wrapper requires `>=0.22.0`. There was no local `../crabbox` checkout or `go` binary available to rebuild it, so I used the repo's local Codex-worktree fallback wrappers.

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior addressed**: Microsoft Teams inbound mention, quoted-reply, and forwarded-message payloads are normalized before the agent receives text.
- **Real environment tested**: Local Linux Codex worktree running the repo's Teams extension test harness and TypeScript lanes on the rebased PR head. Live Teams tenant replay was not available.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch**:

```shell
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.authz.test.ts --reporter=verbose
corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions
OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree corepack pnpm tsgo:extensions:test
git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD
```

- **Evidence after fix**:

```shell
✓ |extension-msteams| extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts > msteams inbound > buildMSTeamsNormalizedText > preserves inbound mention display names
✓ |extension-msteams| extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts > msteams inbound > buildMSTeamsNormalizedText > strips inline quoted markers without injecting quote preview into body text
✓ |extension-msteams| extensions/msteams/src/inbound.test.ts > msteams inbound > buildMSTeamsNormalizedText > labels forwarded message bodies from Teams HTML attachments
✓ |extension-msteams| extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.authz.test.ts > msteams monitor handler authz > normalizes mentions, quoted replies, and forwards before dispatch
✓ |extension-msteams| extensions/msteams/src/monitor-handler/message-handler.authz.test.ts > msteams monitor handler authz > does not expose quotedReply preview from blocked senders

Test Files  2 passed (2)
Tests  57 passed (57)
[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 21.43s
```

- **Observed result after fix**: The focused Teams tests pass with coverage for mention display-name preservation, bot mention stripping, quoted marker removal, `quotedReply` supplemental context, blocked quoted sender filtering, and forwarded-body labeling. Both extension TypeScript lanes and `git diff --check` also passed.
- **What was not tested**: I did not run a live Microsoft Teams tenant capture/replay because no private Teams credentials or live session were available in this environment. The preferred remote Testbox lane was blocked by the stale local `crabbox` binary noted above.
